fields.name: region
fields.description: Region/market code, e.g., US. Max length 1000

fields.name: dateRange
fields.description: Time range, e.g., last7Day (last 7 days), last30Day (last 30 days). Max length 1000

fields.name: pageNumber
fields.description: Page number, value range 1-5 (out of range returns errcode 501)

fields.name: language
fields.description: Return language, e.g., zh-CN, en-US. Max length 1000

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Currency unit, e.g., USD. Max length 1000

fields.name: sortField
fields.description: Sort criteria; pass an empty object {} for default rank order when not sorting

fields.name: shopId
fields.description: TikTok shop unique ID (string, to avoid large integer precision loss), e.g., 7495514739648989419. Obtainable from the shop_id field in the shop rank response
